notes.title: 1.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Greetings, Merchants!

We've overhauled the game to tackle some unfortunate issues that have been plaguing players since the game launched in March. We appreciate everyone's support and immense patience as we ironed this all out.

Please note that this patch will go live tomorrow on June 27th, 2025 at 11:30 AM Central Time / 12:30 PM Eastern Time.

If you continue to run into the issues that were meant to be fixed in this patch, please join our Discord server and utilize our bug report forums to let us know.


1.0.3 Patch NotesQuests
Fixed "Appeal to the City" quest intro playing twice.

Updated the "Write Mehdi A Letter" quest description.

Fixed the "New Recruits" quest recruitment date.

Fixed the "Chasing An Echo" quest deadline text.

Removed the unused quest, "Stationary Work".

Added Renown 8 completion to "FREE Business" to allow the player to complete the quest.

Changed the "Echo Lake" quest dates to avoid overlap with with other quests.

Removed the quest rewards section.

Fixed quest locations not appearing without a reload.
Player Shop & Companions
Potentially fixed the issue with Front Of House assignments causing your shop to crash.

Fixed the End Of Week percentage to always equate to 100%.

Fix item price resetting the quantity to 1 when selecting a different item.

Fixed Front Of House companion slots not updating the Back Of House companion slots.

Fixed the upgrade button playing sounds when you can't afford the upgrade.

Fixed Front Of House assignment stats resetting when leaving the Front Of House UI.

Companions now face their workstations.

Fixed Rumor containers by preventing them from expanding the End of Day results.

Fixed shelves appearing stocked when they're empty.

Fixed Companion assignment not being aborted when leaving the Back Of House UI.

Force the player to hire a Companion when available.

Fixed an issue that allowed players to level a Companion multiple times at once.
Settings, Saves, & UI
Prevented the Save menu from refreshing multiple times.

Fixed the Settings menu checking a default setting that is no longer in use.

Fixed Back To Menu button in the credits not working.

Updated the Save slot to reflect the currently loaded save data in memory, which should also display the correct checkpoint.

Disable escaping on the Game Over screen.

Auto-resized item tags.

Fixed resizing on event labels.

Fixed Tooltips displaying off-screen at specific resolutions.

Add a description to the item, Piccolo Sheet Music.

Disabled the Map button to stop the player from not closing any pop-up.

Fixed Compendium cards loading after setting pin status, update pin stats when Compendium details are loaded from a fresh save.

Fixed pop-ups appearing more than once when hitting enter.

Moved the crafting icon above the item icon in inventory items.
Dialogue
Fixed the issue with dialogue failing and causing the game to hang.

Removed excess fades in dialogue.

Slowed down dialogue skip to avoid characters appearing incorrectly.

Added auto resizing text labels.

Fixed the edge case bug where you can skip to finishing the game early.

Fixed dialogue sometimes wiping the active quest.
Miscellaneous Fixes
Fixed duplicate events from generating.

Fixed time tracking regarding the amount of hours played.

Fixed the Ambience playing on the local map.

Optimized Marketplace and ItemDetails to help the load time of shops, especially during end-game stages.

Fixed the NPC Gems not taking the player's money.

Fixed bundle purchase sounds being used for other purchases.

notes.title: 1.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Fixed progression issues for 2 quests: Guilded Union, Messenger Seagull.
 Fixed an issue where the game would freeze on an End Of Week screen.
 Fixed an issue that caused an unwarranted "Game Over" fail state.
 Minor fixes and edits like typos, music issues, and Quill requirements for a quest.

notes.title: Launch Week Patch
notes.content:
Good afternoon, Merchants!

Our first patch is now live! Thank you so much for everyone's support and patience as we worked on fixing the bugs that popped up during our launch week. 

If you continue to run into the issues that were meant to be fixed in this patch, please join our Discord server and utilize our bug report forums to let us know.

1.0.1 Patch Notes

 Fixed memory leaks that were causing crashes / overuse of resources on some PCs.
 Made improvements to how the save system works.
 Fixed the issue where the Workshop Wonderland achievement wasn't unlocking. (Don't worry, this achievement will now pop up for anyone that unlocked it before the patch!)
 Fixed issues where some quests were not completing on specific in-game dates.
 Fixed an issue that caused some objective locations to disappear after loading in.
 Fixed an issue that caused freezing during the day transition animation.
 Updated the descriptions on some quests that didn't have enough information.

notes.title: A Merchant’s Guide to Rosewall
notes.content:
Hey, Merchant! Welcome to the city of Rosewall, where you can make all your dreams come true as long as those dreams are all “Run a really cool and successful shop!” The first step to achieving that dream is to understand how to run a shop at all—the cool and successful part will come later*. I’m Chrys, and here’s everything you need to know about running a shop and living in Rosewall! 

Buy (and make) Low, Sell High

Did you know food, clothes, furniture, art, and all the other things around you are made of other things? It’s true! Whether they’re called “ingredients,” “materials,” “supplies,” or “Chrys stop I’m using that,” You’ll find whatever you need at The Parade, a huge marketplace where different vendors sell different things, sometimes on different days! You can then use those things to make all the things you want using recipes, which you’ll find and gather the longer you run your shop. Prices can change every day, so make sure you check in often! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911982/90162ef697f2b138547942d6ab7c23b8ebdda7d8.png

Hire Slow, Assign Quick 

You can’t make everything (or anything at all, if we’re being honest) on your own. As you build up your shop you’ll hire cooks, stonemasons, artists, and more to make all those wonderful recipes you’ve been collecting. Be sure to assign them to the right workstation, though, since you can’t make a dress with a stove. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911982/94b859450318c56adb8ecb5e5639a701c1dfb0ed.png

Stock, Sell, Survive 

All that stuff your employees make needs to sell! Before you open your shop, you can stock your shelves with the best stuff you’ve got, assign people to tend the shop (you’re a very busy boss, after all), and talk to shoppers. Customers are fickle and will want different things on different days. The better you keep track of customer desires and cater to them, the better you’ll do. 

It’s all fun and games here, but you also need to hit your quotas. Every month, The Estoq Trading Company (your bosses) are going to ask for their share. If you can’t make your quote for the month, your shop is done for. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911982/626fc8e3dc2f9a36af44c7afa56fa25da34805fa.png

It’s Who (And What) You Know

The longer you live in Rosewall, the more you’ll learn about the city and its people. Holidays, weather patterns, and more could affect the cost of resources and the sell price of all your goods, so make sure you’re keep up with your people! This includes the folks who work for you and visit your shop on occasion. You might be able to help people resolve some personal problems or even uncover a conspiracy at the heart of the city. I personally doubt anything like that is actually happening, but you never know.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911982/8439fcbfa49ab0011efdc35bf086028da32b8c4b.png 

Have fun! 

Remember: The whole point of running a shop is to have fun. Well, I assume that’s the case. I’ve never run a shop. I’m just a receptionist. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911982/b93389645d6f71ee9b1dcae5488fd685a194a756.png
Sincerely, Chrys
Guild Hall of Rosewall Receptionist

*Coolness and success not guaranteed. Investing quills and self-worth into monetary endeavors involves risk and potential loss of coolness. For more details, look it up.

notes.title: Reintroducing - The Sprites!
notes.content:
Cute lil guys turned studio mascots turned in-game helpers, we introduced them as The Blobs but they're now known as Sprites! Let us know who your favorite is in the comments!


The [strike]Blobs[/strike] Sprites

I'm in charge here so I'm posting my favorite lil guy first - the Earth Sprite!

A reliable, down to earth kind of Sprite, they're likely to be found nestling in a pothole in the road or in an empty space of a brick wall.

Or in this case, hangin' out in Brolly's satchel! 🪨

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911982/497e4bf187a8129b085978b501e3fc53634c9de0.png

We've made the Sprites super expressive, so they will often share the same mood as the people they've chosen to follow.

Fire Sprites are full of compassion and warmth, and are sometimes known to sleep inside of street lamps to light up the city.

We like their spark! 🔥

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911982/30e4aa1a2c2a44c476e7ac3477af2d4f81ccc942.png

Chrys is the Guild Hall receptionist in Merchants of Rosewall, as well as the mascot for the game! She shares all the hot goss with her Sprite.

The sweet, bouncy Air Sprites always have their heads in the cloud, and often find themselves in high, hard to reach places. ☁️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911982/96e987a065af285833a6816417c86ffc0f929423.png

Did you know that Sprites can change their shape if they feel like it? Well, of course you wouldn't know that, but you do now.

Water Sprites are gentle, excitable, and great for keeping you cool during the warmer seasons.

They'll never rain on your parade! 💧

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911982/9790c56cefd095c45e71b466549aba3edfe3f264.png

notes.title: New trailer, publisher announcement, and more!
notes.content:
Greetings, Merchants! 🪙 This past week has been quite a whirlwind, so here's what you missed:

🌹New trailer for Merchants of Rosewall.
Merchants of Rosewall had the honor of having our newest trailer premiere during the PC Gaming Show: Most Wanted showcase last week, alongside so many other awesome indie games! Click here to watch the trailer, and leave a like!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911982/d59624a5da06290c1429a5ae9baa6c5339d346bf.png

🎮 We're publishers now!
We are so happy to finally be able to share that we're teaming up with Kitten Cup Studio (creators of Pekoe) to publish their 2nd game, Capy Castaway! Head over to their Steam page to wishlist the game and follow their socials to keep up to date with this cozy, whimsical adventure.

"Embark on a whimsical adventure with a capybara pup and a clever crow as they set off to find their way home! Sniff, dig, and explore a vibrant world brimming with wonder, challenges, and heartwarming friendships at every turn."

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911982/be0138bd4afa653e3f302519847a0efd58709bc8.png

🚂 Sneak peek?
Before we go, we want to leave you with a look at one of the loading screens. We have so much more to show you soon, so we hope you'll stick around.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911982/a3822a7299bb63268aeabbbabe530dbe91605d22.png

And with that, we wish you happy holidays, and we'll see you in the new year!

- Cait & the Big Blue Sky Games team! ☃️

notes.title: Professions and Companions!
notes.content:
Greetings, Merchants!
We wanted to give you a little update on what we have revealed so far, including what kind of content we'll be showing off soon! What are you looking forward to? What reveal have you enjoyed the most so far?

Professions
Take a look at the 6 different professions available in the game!  🪚🍳🧵🪨🎨⚒️

Do you want to run a shop that sells baked goods and jewelry? Maybe floral arrangements and handmade garments? Pick and choose whichever feels right for your shop - Rosewall is your oyster!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911982/0a9efd5d86356eee6ed1a4ff07bf3578ffe7d1d1.png

Companions
We have a HUGE pool of Companions for you to recruit to provide perks and bonuses in their chosen disciplines, but you'll also be able to get to know them through each of their unique storylines. Here are 4 Companions that you will meet in Merchants of Rosewall.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911982/eded758f96271af3acc92e349a68e81203ca0b98.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911982/ea91079ff2c988c089b255c8f01001c039f4ae0c.png

We'll also be celebrating Pride Month soon, so we'll have some fun things to share all through the month of June!
